title: Target success KPIs for Tailwind Traders

spec.title: Target success KPIs for Tailwind Traders
spec.lead: Success is measured against three quantitative targets across reporting speed, quality, and run cost.

headline.label: Target: faster report build cycles
headline.text: Cutting cross-channel merchandising and inventory reporting turnaround in half
headline.note: Measured from business request to published Looker dashboard

items.label: Target: automated data quality pass rate
Target: lower platform operational run cost
Target: report generation time reduction
items.text: Replaces two-week manual report preparation across 400 stores and online channels with automated daily insights on Google Cloud.

spec.notes:
We anchor the engagement on three measurable target KPIs for Tailwind Traders. We aim to cut report build cycles by 50%, achieve a 95% automated data quality pass rate in Dataplex, and reduce platform operational run costs by 30% through BigQuery slot management and partition lifecycle controls.
Check before sharing: figures not found in the research sources (95%, 95%).
